editorial.blurb: Gordo's Tiny Taco Bar delivers authentic, freshly made Mexican food in a welcoming downtown spot with genuine hospitality and a vibrant atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Don't miss the daily specials like the two-tacos-with-rice-and-beans deal—great value for the generous portions. Come early on weekdays for a less crowded but still lively experience.

topDishes.note: flavorful and substantial, part of popular specials
